# publish-quality-gate

> Fixed publish-process gate: before publish, four layers of sensitive-information checks (company / machine / personal / secrets) with zero-hit per layer; after publish, TRACE five-dimension AI self-test (Trust / Reliability / Adaptability / Convention / Effectiveness).

An Agent Skill in the SynomosAI ecosystem. Applies to every external release (Skill, expert package, doc, HTML, PPT, tool).

## Core

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/publish-quality-gate/blob/main/SKILL.md): skill main file (four-layer checklist + TRACE dimensions)
- [scripts/check_release.py](https://github.com/SynomosAI/publish-quality-gate/blob/main/scripts/check_release.py): quick release check script
- [ATTESTATION.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/publish-quality-gate/blob/main/ATTESTATION.md): ownership attestation
- [manifest.json](https://github.com/SynomosAI/publish-quality-gate/blob/main/manifest.json): package fingerprint and per-file sha256
- [README.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/publish-quality-gate/blob/main/README.md): Chinese overview
- [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/publish-quality-gate/blob/main/LICENSE.md): MIT
